never: let production read the index or the pile instead of live nodes
promote a node to live on confidence
invent a node type or an edge type the contract does not name
let the model pick a winner between two live nodes
treat customer files or interviews as a source
stays_with_person: accepting a source into the library
accepting a proposed node or edge as live
accepting a change delta so affected nodes may answer again
declaring two entities the same thing
any statement that the graph is complete or approved for client use

provider_block.job: a fact lives once, and retiring a source takes its answers with it

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the business's own corpus, register ids and accepted library. Identity, the change list and acceptance are the three parts not to hand-roll, and they are data, not a product.

checks.title: The key contract is written and versioned before the first extract
Every source is registered as an instrument, not a file path
No node is live without a named acceptance and a replayable locator
Production reads live nodes, and a card names a node, never a file
Entity identity comes from a system of record, or SAME_AS is an accepted edge
Scope is an APPLIES_TO edge, and an unscoped clause cannot answer a scoped question
Supersession and conflict are written edges, and the model never picks a winner
Replacing a source produces a delta with a computed list of affected nodes
Proposed, live, conflict, change_pending and retired are states, not labels
The index can propose and rank. Emptying it does not empty the graph and does not invent an answer
Customer files and interviews are not sources unless a person promotes a claim
